<quote by="Proposed: Hercynia, Seconded: Miaren">To construct Micah's Stand wayhouse in High Chalcis, Reikos as described in the civil service records. Title to be appointed by unanimous decision of Navarr senators. Cost: 12ww, 12wg, 72cr. Self funded.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[wayhouse]] in High Chalcis, Reikos as per the '''[[Wasp_nest#Stand_for_a_Dream|Wasp nest]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed

==Date==
* Winter 386YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 12 weirwood
* 12 white granite
* 72 crowns
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Micah%27s_Stand}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, Micah's Stand has had the following effects:
* Increases the production of the [[Benefactor of High Chalcis]] to eight of each herb.
* Increases the great work production of the Gardens of High Chalcis by one Imperial roseweald
* The [[Keeper of the Stand]] will be available to appoint by unanimous decision of Navarr senators for the first time at the Spring Equinox 387YE
